body:
Claim: PM loop round 1 (epic objectstack-ai/objectstack#11586, maintainer direct-dispatch channel)
Session: `session_71836b57-5db6-459d-ae4d-c6d9d7dd2cc6`
Branch: `claude/issue-11587-org-join-link-v1`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-11587`
Domain: `domain:services`
File surface: `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/**` (endpoints + wiring), `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/**` (new object + tests), `packages/spec/src/kernel/public-auth-features.ts` (gate booking; error-code ledger if new codes require it) (stop on breach; explain in the report)
Container & model: L, `mode:subagent`, `model: claude-fable-5` — Clause-② mandatory tier (widens the public API surface); `dispatch-gates --tier` is a floor, the content limb mandates the ceiling here
Clause-②: yes
Serial constraints cleared: open PRs scanned — #11560 / #11406 touch `packages/spec` parse layer (different files than the ledger; no overlap), no open PR touches plugin-auth or platform-objects identity (#11530 and #11562 both MERGED — same-day churn on `sys-member.object.ts`/`public-auth-features.ts`, so base on fresh origin/main and re-read those files). Sibling sub-issues objectui#5961 / cloud#1633 are `pm:blocked` on this card — never same batch.
Note: `mode:subagent` tier is not self-provable ⇒ `needs:contract-review` chain applies at ACCEPT regardless of the dispatched tier.

Audit (direct-dispatch): maintainer instruction, 2026-08-24 chat, quoted verbatim: 「可以，你开一个epic任务，用objectstack项目经理技能统一派发处理」. Epic delegation recorded on the parent; the spec-adjacent booking is dispatched by the epic PM under that instruction rather than transferred to the spec seat (deviation recorded on the parent).

Container & model correction: `model: claude-fable-5` → `model: opus`, availability exemption.

Reading: three consecutive dispatch attempts (one fresh + two SendMessage revivals, 5-minute backoff between) each terminated mid-run by API `529 Overloaded`, with ZERO durable output (no worktree, no remote branch — verified before each revival). fable is measurably unavailable right now; per the maintainer's standing exemption (2026-08-13, verbatim): 「fable 如果用完了，可以用 opus」. Not downgrading further.

Clause-② remains `yes` and is compensated as designed: the `needs:contract-review` chain at ACCEPT runs at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` regardless of the implementation tier (the review exists precisely to compensate a below-floor dispatch). Re-dispatching a fresh agent now; branch/worktree names unchanged from the claim.

Dispatch paused — upstream provider incident. Four consecutive dev runs (3× fable, 1× opus after the recorded downgrade) were killed mid-run by API 529 Overloaded with zero durable output. status.claude.com has an active incident: "elevated errors on requests to Claude Mythos 5, Claude Fable 5, Claude Opus 5, and other Claude models" (Investigating 05:06 UTC, Identified 05:27 UTC, 2026-08-24). This is infra-wide, not tier-specific — the earlier fable→opus downgrade reading is superseded by this one; the model choice will be re-evaluated at resume (fable if available, per the original Clause-② mandate). Claim stands; a recovery timer is set to resume dispatch when the incident clears.

Resuming dispatch on a live probe reading (not on the status page, which still shows the 05:27 UTC "Identified" entry): a minimal fable-tier subagent round-trip just succeeded, so the channel is usable — the incident is an elevated error RATE, not an outage. Model returns to `claude-fable-5` per the Clause-② mandate, as promised in the pause comment. The dev is instructed to push early and commit/push after each unit so progress survives any further intermittent kill.

PAUSED by the maintainer — the audience assumption behind this epic was corrected.

Maintainer, 2026-08-24 chat, quoted verbatim: 「协作者不会多，我在云端手工加入都可以，主要是 业务用户怎么方便的注册进来，你先和我讨论方案。」

This epic builds the **cloud-organization** join link — membership in the control plane, i.e. the COLLABORATOR layer (env list, development, billing visibility). The maintainer states that layer is low-volume and manual invitation is acceptable, so the epic's justification is withdrawn for now. The real need is the **business-user** layer: convenient self-registration into a tenant ENVIRONMENT (e.g. `steedos.objectos.ai`), which is a different runtime, different tables, different auth surface — the code here does not transfer.

Dispatch stopped mid-run; branch `claude/issue-11587-org-join-link-v1` exists with partial work and is left in place. No PR was opened.

Restart-when: the business-user onboarding design (under discussion with the maintainer 2026-08-24) concludes and the maintainer rules that a cloud-org join link is still wanted.

Live readings that informed the correction (measured on `steedos.objectos.ai` `/api/v1/auth/config`, 2026-08-24): `emailPassword.disableSignUp=false`, `requireEmailVerification=false`, `socialProviders=[objectstack-cloud]`, `features.ssoEnforced=false`, `tenancyPosture=single`. Env-side self-registration is open and unverified today, and `reconcileMembership` (policy default `auto`) auto-binds each new user into the env's single org — that is the surface the business-user design must address.

Closing **not planned** — the hold's `Restart-when:` condition has fired, and the answer is "not wanted now".

That condition was: *the business-user onboarding design concludes and the maintainer rules whether a cloud-org join link is still wanted.* The design concluded today as objectstack-ai/objectstack#11723 (audience posture, ruled and dispatched). The maintainer's ruling on the collaborator layer, quoted verbatim from the 2026-08-24 chat, is:

> 「协作者不会多，我在云端手工加入都可以，主要是 业务用户怎么方便的注册进来，你先和我讨论方案。」

Manual invitation covers the collaborator (cloud-organization) layer at current volume, so this epic has no pull. Per the maintainer's standing guidance (2026-08-16, verbatim: 「我建议有些暂时不准备开发的应该直接关闭。」), work with no firable restart condition is closed rather than held — the card IS the record, and reopening is free.

Preserved for whoever revives this: the V1 token shape reasoned out here (one active link per org, role pinned to `member`, default 7-day expiry, revoke/rotate, optional max-uses, membership written through the governed `addMember` path, verified-email posture per better-auth GHSA-fmh4-wcc4-5jm3) is directly reusable if a `link` value is ever added to the audience-posture vocabulary in #11723. Branch `claude/issue-11587-org-join-link-v1` holds partial work; no PR was opened.
